## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Spanish-language 2D fighting game for phones/tablets, then improve its movement and mobile presentation.

## Requirements
- Original request: local friend-versus mode and five story levels, each up to five minutes.
- Follow-up: “Hazlo más fluido, que el mapa de fondo sea un ring de luchas, que el salto sea acia arriva y no hacía abajo, arregla la sona segura de la pantalla y que se pueda jugar con el teléfono de lado”.

## Decisions
- Game titled **Ritmo de Acero**; implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game in `index.html`.
- Assumed local multiplayer means both players share one device.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented home, level select, fighter selection, combat, keyboard and touch controls, timer, health/meters, AI opponent, pause/results, and progressive story unlocks in `index.html`.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully after initial implementation.
### Active
- Improve responsiveness and fluidity; replace city-like background with a fighting ring; ensure jump visibly goes up; correct safe-area handling; support landscape play on phones.
### Blocked
- Browser check was attempted but blocked because Chromium is not installed (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`).

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` for the latest requested changes.
2. Make the arena render as a boxing/fighting ring rather than a city background.
3. Tune movement/jump/render timing and verify jump height/visual direction.
4. Apply safe-area insets consistently and optimize mobile landscape layout; consider prompting orientation where supported.
5. Check JavaScript syntax and, if browser tooling becomes available, verify in a landscape mobile viewport.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation; all requested follow-up changes remain to be made here.

## Important Context
- Current changes are uncommitted.
- Existing code already gives jump negative vertical velocity (`p.vy=-540`) and renders using `base=h*.79-p.y`; follow-up suggests perceived jump direction/behavior is still wrong.
- `render()` currently draws skyline buildings and floor perspective lines, not a fighting ring.

- Fight canvas `resizeFight()` updates dimensions on window resize; game time is capped at five minutes.

## Objective
- Improve **Ritmo de Acero**, a Spanish-language 2D fighting game for phones and tablets, with smoother gameplay, a fighting-ring arena, upward-looking jumps, safe-area support, and landscape play.

## Requirements
- Support local two-player and five-level story modes, with fights lasting up to five minutes.
- Make the game usable on phones and tablets in landscape orientation.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a standalone HTML canvas implementation in `index.html`.
- Local multiplayer means both players share one device.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a fighting-ring background with ropes, posts, mat, and ring markings.
- Changed fighter rendering so negative jump height visibly moves fighters upward.
- Smoothed player movement and added velocity-based hit particles.
- Added safe-area spacing for gameplay UI and compact landscape layouts; hid the top bar during fights.
- Added resize and orientation-change handling and scaled fighter positions with canvas resizing.

### Active
- Validate the changes, especially movement, jump behavior, and mobile landscape/safe-area layouts.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was previously unavailable because Chromium was not installed.

## Next Move
1. Run a JavaScript syntax check on `index.html`.
2. Verify the game in a browser if one is available; adjust any layout or gameplay issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: standalone game; all current changes are here.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The previous checkpoint reported JavaScript syntax checking had passed before these latest edits; it has not been rerun since.
